Ricky and his band are going on a tour and Lucy wants to go too. She dusts off her old saxophone and goes down to the club dressed in a zoot suit to audition for a spot.

The Ricardos' eleventh wedding anniversary is coming up and Ricky doesn't seem to be picking up the none-too-subtle hints Lucy is giving. She doesn't realize that Ricky has already made plans to buy a string of pearls at a discount from their neighbor.
After seeing Fred use a pair of trick handcuffs, Lucy uses a similar pair to attach herself to Ricky as gag. She wants him to stay at home and not go to a rehearsal for a live TV show the next day.

The Mertzes and Ricardos feel that their marriages are in a rut and they decide to follow the advice of a book and take a brief vacation from each other. The women move in together as do the guys but they soon all find that they miss each other.

Lucy and Ethel's club must put on an operetta to commemorate its 25th anniversary. However, Lucy, the club treasurer, admits to Ethel that for the past couple of years, she has been mismanaging both the club's budget and her own household budget.

For the Mertzes' twenty-fifth wedding anniversary, Lucy and Ricky present them with a television set. As they are watching it, Ricky's constant adjustments cause the set to explode. Fred gets even by kicking in the Ricardos' TV set.

Lucy and Ethel enter a contest for new home furnishings. If they are the lucky winner, they must be home the next day to receive a phone call. Unfortunately Ricky has four tickets to a new musical which he really wants to see.

The Tropicana club is about to re-open under new management and is looking to Ricky to put on the best possible show. The only problem is that Ricky has come down with a terrible case of laryngitis, and is unable to talk, much less sing.

Not feeling well, Lucy takes herself to the doctor and receives the happy news that she is pregnant. Ethel and Fred find out before Ricky and eagerly begin dreaming about being the lucky godparents. Getting the news to Ricky is not as easy.

A doting husband and father-to-be, Ricky makes the mistake of giving more attention to the arriving baby than he does to his fickle wife. Ricky tries to please Lucy by making her waffles and he doubles his efforts by giving Lucy baby gifts.

Ricky is holding auditions for a new revue he's putting on at the Tropicana. Ricky tells Fred and Ethel that they should audition, but a pregnant Lucy wants part of the spotlight as well. Ricky doesn't go for the idea, so Lucy sneaks into an audition.

Wanting to provide the best environment possible for her child, Lucy decides that she and Ricky should learn to speak proper English. Lucy makes a deal with a tutor who will teach English to the Ricardos.

After members of her club throw her a baby shower, Lucy realizes that Ricky has become jealous of the attention she and the baby are receiving. She consults with a doctor when Ricky complains about nausea, dizziness, and stomach ache.

Lucy decides that their unborn child should have artistic leanings, so she takes up sculpting. The fast-talking salesman in the art supply store she visits sells her an enormous amount of modeling clay, claiming she has talent.

With her baby due any moment, Lucy finds it challenging trying to remain calm given Ricky's nervous behavior. When she asks the Mertzes to come over to offset Ricky, she winds up with three very anxious people.
Lucy gets caught up in a tormenting cycle of buying a useless appliance from a fast-talking salesman, then trading it in for something more expensive when trying to return it.

Could it be? Is Lucy Ricardo not funny? When Lucy's jokes fail to crack a smile amongst her friends and husband, she begins to develop an inferiority complex. Her depression gets worse when she discovers she's no good at bridge.

Ethel flashes back to the time when she and Lucy raced to win the presidency of their club, the Wednesday Afternoon Fine Arts League. When Ethel was nominated for the position, Lucy bribed another member to nominate her.

Fred and Ethel overhear a fight between Ricky and Lucy...or did they? It seems Lucy is reading a murder mystery out loud to the amusement of Ricky. But when Ricky playfully throws the book at Lucy, she ends up with a black eye.
The Ricardos and Mertzes are out a restaurant and Lucy keeps changing her order and their seating. Ricky points out that she constantly changes her mind and never completes things.

The Ricardos' infant is cranky and keeps his parents as well as their neighbors up at night. When a neighbor, Mrs. Trumbull points out that the lease forbids children and threatens to move out along with other tenants.

Lucy and Ricky are exhausted from walking the baby at night and hire a maid. Lucy prepares a list of dos and don'ts in order to set down the law for her new employee. However when Mrs. Porter arrives, she has her own list for her employer.

Lucy wants to get into the act when Ricky is producing an Indian show at the Tropicana. Ricky instead hires the Mertzes to be part of the show, hoping Lucy will be cured of her show biz bug now that she is a mother.
Ricky has planned a surprise party for Lucy's birthday and swears the Mertzes and all their friends to secrecy. Lucy, however, only knows that everyone has forgotten her birthday.

Lucy decides that the Ricardos need a bigger apartment. She discovers that an older couple in the building just had their daughter move out and they no longer need the extra space. All she needs to do is to convince Ricky to go along with the trade.

An eligible bachelor is in town, and Lucy wants to set him up with a girlfriend of hers. The bachelor is a lingerie salesman by the name of Eddie Grant who is a friend of the Mertzes. Unfortunately, Lucy's attempts at matchmaking fail.
Without consulting Ricky, Lucy buys new living room furniture, using their old set as a down payment. Waiting for the right moment to tell Ricky the news, she hides the new furniture in the kitchen.

Lucy feels that she and Ricky are growing apart because they don't share many of the same interests. To make up for this, Lucy decides to invite herself along to a camping trip that Ricky and Fred are going on.

programmes.d: Dismayed that they can't seem to unglue their husbands from the boxing match on TV, Lucy and Ethel decided to go out for a bite to eat. However, at the local café they run into a similar problem.

The Ricardos have just purchased a new washing machine and despite their better judgment, agree to sell their old one to the Mertzes. The next day the old machine explodes with water and suds and the Mertzes insist that the deal is off.
Life magazine does a photo layout on the Ricardos and the only part of Lucy visible in the shot is her elbow. Lucy insists on getting a part in Ricky's act so that she can make a name for herself.

Jane must get over the newest hurdle in her life, which proves to be harder than she hoped. Rogelio discovers that he and River are not as equal as he thought. Meanwhile, Jane and Petra must deal with the children not getting along.
After talking to everyone else about what is going on in her life, Jane turns to Petra, who she knows will give her a straight answer. In return, Petra leans on Jane for advice about JR.

Jane reluctantly agrees to let Rogelio throw her a big 30th birthday party. Jane's mentor gives her some important advice that may help her start writing again. Meanwhile, Petra thinks she and JR are finally in a good place.

Jane struggles with giving Rafael his space after she discovers that he is hiding a secret. Jane and Michael uncover clues about what happened the day he "died." Petra wants to fit into JR's world and enlists Jane's help.

Jane is trying to go with the flow, so when Michael makes a suggestion that takes her out of her comfort zone, Jane decides to go for it. Jane struggles with her feelings for Raphael while Michael slides back into his old life.

Jane is having a hard time dealing with Rafael avoiding her, so when an issue with Mateo comes up she uses it to get some face time. Rogelio turns to Jane for help when he learns his pilot is in trouble.

When Jane and Rogelio join forces to pitch a pilot, Jane is excited until she discovers a secret about her book being published. Alba and Jorge make an important decision about their future together. Rafael asks Jane to allow Luisa to meet Mateo.
When Rogelio tells Jane that the network wants her to write the script for their telenovela, at first she is excited, but begins to struggle balancing her time between that and her novel.

With Jorge officially moved into Alba's house with his stuff, it quickly has changed the dynamic, making Jane to uncomfortable. Rafael and Jane work on their co-parenting of Mateo now that they have a potential way to help Mateo.

After Rafael witnesses Mateo's behavior at school, he wants to take a different approach to his treatment. Rogelio is paranoid that River is plotting her revenge against him. Meanwhile, Jane convinces Petra to go on a single ladies' night out.

With Jane and Rafael finally in a good place, they are concerned to discover Mateo's treatment might be a problem. Alba and Rogelio are worried about Xo's recent behavior. Meanwhile, Petra is secretly pleased when Rafael and Jane begin fighting.

When Lina comes to town, Jane is excited to see her until Lina asks her for a favor. Rafael begins to work with Petra again but old tensions create new problems between them. Rogelio creates a plan to pressure the network to pick-up his pilot.

After Jane is struck with inspiration for her book, she immediately begins to write, but her next challenge is to get an agent. Rogelio has been so focused on being the star, he begins to contemplate taking on a different role instead.

When Jane's editor pitches her a dark twist for her book, Jane begins to wonder if the same thing might have actually happened to her. Rogelio helps River bond with her daughter, but River once again makes things difficult for him.

Jane is feeling great about all the book publishing prospects she has until an unexpected problem pops up. Petra and Rafael's working relationship has been going so well that Petra makes Rafael an unexpected offer.
Get ready for the finale with cast interviews from the cast of "Jane The Virgin".

With Jane and Rafael finally getting ready for their big day, Rafael's desire to help Jane's writing dream lands him in trouble. Xo and Rogelio must tell the family about their decision and not everyone takes it well.

It's a rainy spring day, and the children can be found inside painting and creating.  Barney arrives, explains the differences amongst the seasons, and suggests playing outside in the rain.  The rain is soon replaced by sunshine and a rainbow.
Every day with Barney is fun—but today is extra special.  It's Barney's birthday!

Tony shares a box full of numbers that he made with his dad.  He is showing them off when a gust of wind blows them all away.  Barney and the kids decide to go on a number hunt.  They soon find Baby Bop and their hunt takes the group all over the park.

Barney and the kids are excited because five of Mr. Boyd's brass-playing buddies are putting on a show in the park tonight!  Angela is learning to play the trumpet and knows that it takes a lot of practice.  BJ arrives and the group visits the caboose.
After a brief misunderstanding, BJ realizes he has many friends.  He enjoys a day playing with Barney and the children.
The children work together to make a bird house.  They are happy to learn that the bird will have lots of company; many animals make their homes in the park too!
The kids have put together a "Caboose Color Collection" which showcases the primary colors—red, yellow and blue.  Barney and Baby Bop enjoy songs and games suggested by the colorful objects.

Barney and the kids help Mr. Boyd prepare his dog Bingo for a trip to the veterinarian for a check, while learning lessons about caring for dogs at the same time.  Meanwhile, BJ is searching for his missing baseball, which he suspects was buried by Bingo.

When Sarah accidentally spills red paint into the blue paint, a mess turns into a perfectly purple day.  The children paint pictures, make purple flowers and plan a purple party for their friend Colleen.

While Barney has fun with his friends every day, there's something special about making a brand NEW friend!  When Mr. Boyd's niece, Colleen visits the park, she's eager to make friends with the other kids...but being the "new kid" isn't easy.
Barney and his friends play hopscotch—with a twist.  Whitney is learning about triangles at school, so Angela created Triangle Hopscotch to help reinforce "triangles."
Through pretend play, Barney, and the children learn about their community and the people that help them live safely and happily there.

The children are invited to a family picnic in the park, but don't know who invited them.  The invitations instruct them to bring a family treasure, so each child has something special with them.  Barney helps lead a discussion about families.
A "too hot" afternoon becomes a "totally cool" day when Barney introduces his friends to the wonders of water.
While Barney and the children wait for Mr. Boyd's new fountain to be delivered, they have fun playing in and exploring the park.
Barney helps his young friends find good ways to express and deal with angry emotions.
Mario is trying to write his very own fairy tale.  The children help by acting out some of their favorite fairy tales to give Mario some ideas.

The children are surprised to learn that playing games and having fun in the park is great exercise.  Baby Bop is happy to learn that not only is she exercising while she plays, but exercise will make her grow big and strong.

Although the park may be a home away from home for Barney and his friends, BJ wants to build his own "totally awesome, completely cool" house.  While BJ works on his house, Barney and the children learn all about houses and homes.
With a little Barney magic, the children experience the differences between day and night!

When Tony brings his kite to the park to show his friends, it accidentally blows into the branches of a tree!  While waiting for a breeze to blow the kite down, Barney, Baby Bop and the kids play games about "up" and "down."
Barney, Baby Bop and the kids learn all about “on” and “off” by playing games together.
A tea party planned by the children turns into a fun opportunity to reinforce lessons about good manners!  Throughout the day, Baby Bop is given helpful advice.
Barney, BJ and the kids spend the day preparing for a performance for their friends in the park.
Throughout the day, Barney and the children learn about "hot" and "cold," but the fun really begins when Barney turns the playground into a winter/summer wonderland!

It's always fun to share a day with Barney—but it's also important to learn how to "play it safe!"  Baby Bop, wanting to be a good helper, has been attaching adhesive strips to her frustrated (and uninjured) brother, BJ.

programmes.st: This Way In, This Way Out!
programmes.d: Angela is in the park to release her turtle after observing him with her classmates in school.  Barney and the children discuss the meaning of in and out after observing the turtle going in and out of his shell.
The children learn about many different countries while experiencing an “International Fair” on the playground.
When Miss Jo loses her cat, Barney and the children spend the day helping her find it.  Along the way, they learn all about cats.

Beth has invented a brand-new holiday called "Happy Day," in which everyone gets to make a wish for something which will make them happy—and everyone else tries to make that wish come true!  Barney and the kids discuss feelings and facial expressions.
The children learn all about the piano when they play games, listen to real pianos and even play a little themselves.

After playing with "Stop" and "Go" signs with Angela, Baby Bop leaves to direct some traffic of her own!  Meanwhile, in the caboose, Barney and the kids enjoy a costume parade, a game of "Musical Stop & Go," and some very vigorous body movement.

It's the day of the bike parade.  But Nick has had a bike accident that leaves his bike in need of repair by Mr. Boyd.  Barney helps Baby Bop and the children learn all about bicycles—and that they are a wonderful way to exercise and have fun.

programmes.st: The Eiffel Tower Becomes a Mountain
programmes.d: Mister Rogers arrives with a juniper tree. Everyone is covering the Eiffel Tower with trees. Queen Sara falls off the tower and is taken to an emergency room. Mister Rogers shows an emergency room.
Mister Rogers arrives with a small kitten that belongs to Chuck Aber. Mister Rogers shows a film about seat belts. King Friday wants to see a mountain opera.
Mister Rogers arrives with a popcorn popper. He is introduced to Ray Detwiler who plays rare horns. Chef Brockett gives a popcorn ball to King Friday who declares there be popcorn in the opera.

Mister Rogers shows a film about how people make towels. The Neighborhood of Make-Believe is hosting the Make-Believe Olympic Games. Lady Elaine will only agree to play if she is guaranteed to win the games.

programmes.st: Mister Rogers Makes a Rocking Chair
programmes.d: Mister Rogers arrives with two pieces of wood and turns a chair into a rocking chair. Lady Aberlin and Bob Dog help Corney make rocking chairs. They are unable to stop rocking thanks to Lady Elaine's boomerang.

Mister Rogers visits a robot factory. A robot talks with Lady Elaine but does not understand the term like. Daniel talks to the robot about caring. Handyman Negri tells Daniel that it's great to love others.

Brandon Margulies explains how to play a video game. Keith David shows how the machine works. In the Neighborhood of Make-Believe, everyone is getting ready for the Olympic games. Lady Elaine has decided  to make it snow.
Folk singer Ella Jenkins visits Mister Rogers and sings and plays a song on a harmonica. Mister Rogers has a Neighborhood board game with the different Make-Believe Neighbors.

Mister Rogers visits a daycare and sees children playing. He talks about why children need to go to day care sometimes. King Friday and Queen Sarah have to leave for a few days but Prince Tuesday does not want a babysitter.

Mister Rogers shows how people make balloons. Lady Elaine tells Prince Tuesday that King Friday and Queen Sara may not be coming back from their trip. Meanwhile, X the Owl continues his lessons from the OCS about Native Americans.

Mister Rogers visits the United States Postal Service and sees how stamps are designed and made. There's a heat wave in the Neighborhood of Make-Believe. Neighbors do what they can to keep cool and comfortable!

programmes.st: Work: Visit to a Dairy Farm
programmes.d: Mister Rogers visits a dairy farm to see how cows are milked and milk is bottled. In the Neighborhood of Make-Believe, a contractor helps King Friday plan a budget for the pool. Neighbors decide to reduce costs by helping to dig the hole.

Mister Rogers has a leak in his kitchen faucet and works to fix it. In Make-Believe there are lots of different kinds of work to do to build the swimming pool. A pipe breaking in the midst of digging changes the neighbors' plans.

programmes.st: Work: Visit to a Grocery Store
programmes.d: Mister Rogers visits a grocery store. In the Neighborhood of Make-Believe, neighbors grapple with the dilemma of whether to replace their old pipes with new ones or build a swimming pool.

programmes.st: The People Who Came Before Us
programmes.d: In the Neighborhood of Make-Believe, a new flying trolley comes with a message that Collette, Grandpere's granddaughter, will be coming for a visit.
Mister Rogers shows pictures of his own parents and visits Negri's Music Shop where jazz violinist John Blake and his son play music.
Mister Rogers talks about hobbies like reading. Collette says her hobby is taking pictures of jungle animals. Daniel questions if he has grandparents. Neighbor Aber assures him that he does.
Mister Rogers plays a recording of grandparents. He visits an aquarium. Lady Aberlin will be a trolley engineer in the Neighborhood opera. Daniel is given the part of the one who wants a granddad.

A whimsical musical story about timid Daniel Tiger who is in search of his long-lost grandfather. There's an aquarium with starfish, an old goat and a Trolley Conductor, all helping each other realize how important families are.

Mister Rogers visits an applesauce factory. In the Neighborhood of Make-Believe, X is waiting for his seeds to arrive. He plants the seeds, but they don't grow. He plays hide-and-seek while waiting. Mister Rogers talks about waiting.

programmes.st: Not Everyone Has Enough to Eat
programmes.d: Mister Rogers makes granola bags and talks about people without enough to eat. In the Neighborhood of Make-Believe, Queen Sara discusses her Food for the World hunger project. Old Goat eats the plants. Mister Rogers talks about sharing.

programmes.st: Some Foods Are Better Than Others
programmes.d: Mister Rogers talks about how some foods are better than others. Chef Brockett makes a tasty snack. In the Neighborhood of Make-Believe, King Friday discovers Old Goat eating from his garden. The King plants seeds everywhere.

Mister Rogers shows a picture book of vegetables and tours a vegetable soup factory. In the Neighborhood of Make-Believe, seeds are growing to send food to Northwood. Daniel thinks he has a tree that grows cans of vegetable soup.
Mister Rogers tells viewers that there are many different kinds of food. Food for the eyes, for the ears, and for the spirit.

Mister Rogers shows a portrait of his father and has his portrait painted. He says no two people are exactly alike. In the Neighborhood of Make-Believe, King Friday gets an "exactly-like-me" portrait. It is a mirror.
Mister Rogers remembers that his parents sometimes had to say "no" to keep him safe. Then, King Friday says "yes" to officiating a wedding.

programmes.st: Mister Rogers Leans to Break Dance
programmes.d: Germaine Vaughan shows Mister Rogers how to break dance. Chrissie Thompson, who is handicapped, visits. In the Neighborhood of Make-Believe, Ana Platypus wants to be in the wedding but can't. Daniel is having trouble being the ring bearer.

Mister Rogers shows photographs of weddings. He goes to Brockett's Bakery to make arroz con leche. In the Neighborhood of Make-Believe, everyone is preparing for a wedding. Daniel is nervous about his role as ring bearer and his costume.

Mister Rogers visits a pottery studio to see how Eva Kwong makes a bowl. Later, Mister Rogers talks about weddings. Betty Okonak Templeton Jones marries James Michael Jones in the Neighborhood of Make-Believe.

programmes.st: Breaking through Enemy Lines! Luffy and Zoro Launch the Counter-Attack!
programmes.d: Doflamingo and Fujitora's agreement to not engage each other lasts for the moment - meaning all eyes are turned towards taking down the Straw Hats and claiming the rewards! And as Luffy starts heading to the Royal Palace, Fujitora stands in his way!

programmes.st: With a Rumbling of the Ground! The God of Destruction - Giant Pica Descends!
programmes.d: Robin, Usopp, the Tontattas and the others make moves to rejoin Luffy as Doflamingo's deadly game rages on! Meanwhile, Kin'emon makes it to the trash heap in his search for his friend Kanjuro - just as Pica emerges in the town.

programmes.st: Gathering into a Powerful Front! Luffy and a Group of Brutal Warriors!
programmes.d: With Luffy & the others recovering from Pica's attack, the game is afoot! Luffy has just enough time to regroup and set out to find Doflamingo, only to find that the dastardly Warlord has more enemies than he might realize! A strange argument breaks out.

programmes.st: Steady Progress! Luffy’s Army vs. Pica!
programmes.d: Don Chin Jao and Elizabello successfully break Pica's giant arm but the rock giant is unfazed and starts throwing even more destructive punches at Luffy and his band of unwanted collaborators! Meanwhile, Navy Admiral Fujitora moves into action.

programmes.st: A Shocking Confession! Law's Soulful Vow!
programmes.d: Luffy and Moocy fast approach the showdown with Doflamingo - while the others with a beef against him continue to tag along. Meanwhile, Violet finds the key to Law's handcuffs, and Rebecca pledges to deliver it to him.

programmes.st: A Big Collision! Chief of Staff - Sabo vs. Admiral Fujitora!
programmes.d: Luffy makes headway toward Doflamingo's refuge, making his way through Doflamingo's guards, while down below Admiral Fujitora faces off against Sabo, who has the power of the Fire Fist from eating the Flare-Flare Fruit!

programmes.st: A Desperate Situation! Luffy Gets Caught in a Trap!
programmes.d: Luffy cuts a lucky break as Kelly Funk shows him a shortcut to the Palace! But all may not be as it seems... Meanwhile, Franky and Zoro are locked in one-on-one duels, while Robin, Rebecca, and Bartolomeo enlist the help of the Tontattas.

programmes.st: A Great Escape! Luffy's Tide-turning Elephant Gun!
programmes.d: Penned in at the bottom of a well, Luffy and Law are caught in a trap! But someone has come to save them who they least expect! Meanwhile, the Tontattas help Franky break in to the SMILE factory, and Bartolomeo resorts to tactics he used in the Colosseum.

programmes.st: A United Front! Luffy's Breakthrough to the Victory!
programmes.d: The Tontattas locate their captive comrades and seem to be able to get the message to them - the prison break is on! Meanwhile, heavy-hitters from the Colosseum turn from wringing each other's necks towards a unified plan.

programmes.st: The Second Samurai! Evening Shower Kanjuro Appears!
programmes.d: Hidden far underground, Kin'emon finds his old friend Kanjuro whose powers allow the two to, quickly, but not elegantly, escape to the surface! Meanwhile, Cavendish shares his fears that the "Birdcage" game Doflamingo is playing has been rigged all along.

programmes.st: A Hard-Fought Battle Against Pica! Zoro's Deadly Attack!
programmes.d: The Tontattas are in full revolt! But can they keep their wits about them long enough to make it out? Meanwhile, Zoro finally gains the upper hand against Pica, and Franky finds a way to deal with Señor Pink.

programmes.st: The Little People's Princess! Captive Mansherry!
programmes.d: Franky finally makes it into the factory and the Tontattas are reunited with their captive friends! But Princess Mansherry is nowhere to be found. Factory manager Kuween becomes irate when ignored and launches an attack on Franky.

programmes.st: Invincible! A Gruesome Army of Headcracker Dolls!
programmes.d: Robin, Rebecca, and Bartolomeo draw closer to the Flower Field on the fourth level of the Royal Palace plateau, but a sudden attack by Gladius' exploding spheres sends Robin and Bartolomeo hurtling towards the level below.

programmes.st: Risking Their Lives! Luffy is the Trump Card for Victory!
programmes.d: Rebecca makes it to the Flower Field alone, but unfortunately finds company there that is less than friendly! Meanwhile, Bartolomeo pushes himself to the limit in order to help Luffy advance, but does he leave himself vulnerable in the process?

programmes.st: A Tearful Reunion! Rebecca and Kyros!
programmes.d: Diamante has Rebecca pinned and completely overpowered. If only the Soldier-san of her youth were able to protect her! Meanwhile, Luffy and Law finally surmount incredible odds to land themselves in striking distance of Doflamingo.

programmes.st: One Shot One Kill! The Man Who Will Save Dressrosa!
programmes.d: Usopp uses Viola's Clairvoyance to prepare his ammunition to take Sugar out! But the slightest hesitation now will spell disaster, and the end of Luffy! Luckily for the Straw Hats, Usopp's ammunition has been specially designed for this situation!

programmes.st: Anger Erupts! Luffy and Law's Ultimate Stratagem!
programmes.d: The final showdown with Doflamingo begins, but the Warlord still has several tricks up his sleeve - including turning one of Luffy's own friends against him! Meanwhile Franky and Señor Pink are in a standoff to find out who is the coolest.

programmes.st: A Noble Family! The True Identity of Doflamingo!
programmes.d: All hopes rest on Luffy and Law being able to take down Doflamingo; but the Warlord has other plans in mind as he gives the two the fight of their lives, and reveals his true, shocking history! Meanwhile, Sabo finds out Fujitora's true intention…

programmes.st: The Ultimate Power! The Secret of the Op-Op Fruit!
programmes.d: With Fujitora's stalemate arousing suspicion in the Navy ranks, Law and Luffy stand seconds away from execution at the hand of Doflamingo! But before he dispatches them both, he shares the secret of his sway over the Celestial Dragons!

programmes.st: Sad Memories! Law, the Boy from the White Town!
programmes.d: The horrible secret of Flevance, the White Town, is revealed, giving clues to Law's traumatic past! A rage born from the lies of the World Government created a child who had the will to kill Corazon!

programmes.st: A Celestial Dragon! Doffy's Stormy Past!
programmes.d: Law's attack on Corazon looks less successful than he thought! And after he's accepted into the Doflamingo Family, Corazon's mysterious silence hides a fact that may save Law's life - and a hidden danger Law must face in Doflamingo himself!

programmes.st: A Rocky Road! Law and Corazon's Journey of Life!
programmes.d: Things grow stranger for Law as he learns the secret behind why Corazon feigns being mute! But the mysterious Corazon's actions are only beginning to baffle Law as he takes him on a journey to cure his White Lead Disease.

programmes.st: The Time is Ticking Down! Seize the Op-Op Fruit!
programmes.d: Corazon's double-dealing with the Navy raises suspicions both with Doflamingo and Law. But all that is secondary as Corazon finally has a chance to grab the Op-Op Fruit during a staged handoff arranged by the Government.

programmes.st: The Moment of Resolution! Corazon's Farewell Smile!
programmes.d: The Op-Op Fruit is in Corazon's hands! But the price he paid to get it might be too high... When Law goes for help, unfortunate coincidences intervene and leave the two vulnerable! Meanwhile, Doflamingo and his clan finally land at Minion Island.

programmes.st: Advance, Law! The Kindhearted Man's Final Fight!
programmes.d: Doflamingo & his Family begin to zero in on Corazon and Law's whereabouts, but Corazon has a plan to hide Law long enough to let him escape, even if that means sacrificing his own life. A chain of lucky coincidences allows the plan to be set into motion.

programmes.st: To Be Free! Law's Injection Shot Blasts!
programmes.d: Violet runs down the status of the open battles raging in Dressrosa - the Straw Hats, the Tontattas, the executives of the Doflamingo Family - all of them clash around the island, but it's Law's revelation to Doflamingo that moves the action forward!

programmes.st: An Intense Battle! Law vs. Doflamingo!
programmes.d: Luffy continues to battle Fake-mingo, but keeps accidentally battling Bellamy instead. Meanwhile the tide of battle turns against Law as painful scars from the past resurface. And Zoro gets unexpected help in his battle with Pica.

programmes.st: A Decisive Battle Against the Executives! Proud Hajrudin!
programmes.d: Bellamy escapes Doflamingo's control, but it might be too late. His long history with Doflamingo unfolds and leads to an inglorious end. Meanwhile, Hajrudin has been beaten down, but a fire still burns in him to pay back the favor he owes!

programmes.st: The Battle of Love! The New Leader Sai vs. Baby 5!
programmes.d: Lao G and Don Chinjao duke it out as each brings their most devastating attacks to the battle. But a misunderstanding caused by Baby 5 has Sai and Don Chinjao distracted - are they distracted enough for Lao G to gain the upper hand?

programmes.st: The Man's Pride! Bellamy's Last Charge!
programmes.d: Law is at the whim of Doflamingo and Trebol, while Luffy still has to deal with Bellamy, who fights to keep his honor even after being released by Doflamingo! Meanwhile, Gladius is about to detonate the ground around Cavendish and Bartolomeo!

programmes.st: A Strong Wind and a Surge! Hakuba vs. Dellinger!
programmes.d: A mysterious force that resembles Cavendish menaces the battlefield - but while it appears to help Bartolomeo and the others at first, it sets its sights on Robin! Meanwhile, the deeply-wounded Ideo sees Dellinger's horrible true nature!

Bartolomeo is in a neck-and-neck battle against Gladius to save Robin, and is faced with an impossible dilemma. With all his options leading to their defeat, can his cunning ploy save the day? Meanwhile, Robin is face to face with Cavendish.

Princess Mansherry's amazing power - to heal living beings completely - is in the hands of the Donquixote executive. If she is able to heal all the executives who've gone down in battle - the Straw Hats and their allies stand no chance!
Detectives investigate a secret affair, a kidnapping plot and a racist gang when a young husband-to-be is found shot and stabbed.

When a devoted mother is stabbed to death in a horrifying attack, suspicion falls on those closest to her; a cryptic note and a violent crime spree baffle detectives at first, but they eventually track down a deranged killer no one predicted.

A vibrant young mother of three is murdered in the safety of her own home and investigators look to a history of troubled romances, but when the case goes cold and police can't find the killer, a phone call leads to a culprit hiding in plain sight.
An assassination, a bitter custody dispute and a gunman's cryptic words send police scrambling on an interstate hunt to find the killer of a beloved father and husband.

When the strangling death of a young mother and bride-to-be baffles police, detectives probe a workplace grievance in search of a killer, before a cherished possession provides a link to the crime and cracks the case wide open.

A wealthy trader and father of four is gunned-down at home while his family is tied up in a closet; police dig into affairs, mob links and a missing co-worker, until a new lead and a taped phone call reveal a plot decades later.

When a young mother is found dead in a field after a night out, police scour security video to retrace a suspect's steps; the discovery of a second crime scene leads to an arrest, before high-tech forensics reveal a truth no one expected.

A cat-loving and recently divorced young woman dipping her toes back in the dating game is beaten and strangled in a brutal and unusual way; investigators dive into the murky world of online dating to hunt a killer who could be ready to strike again.

Detectives discover the badly beaten body of a single young woman left bizarrely staged on her bed; fear in the community grows amid a rash of nearby murders until police are handed a break when a fresh look at old evidence points to the killer.

A beloved teacher and mother of four silently vanishes in the middle of the night; a blood-soaked bedroom and lakeside discovery point police to a killer close to home until mysterious tracks in the mud lead to a culprit no one suspected.

When a loving father of two is gunned down on his driveway, police uncover a hidden affair and workplace grudges before a nervous witness and chilling confession reveal a vicious vendetta from a killer no one expected.

When a family that runs a beloved vet clinic is gunned down, police investigate disgruntled tenants, a pet owner with an ax to grind and an estranged son; the case stalls until detectives uncover a twisted plot by someone who seemed above suspicion.
When a young mother and beloved coworker is found stabbed in her bedroom, investigators are unable to pin down a killer until secret recordings and evidence stashed in a van are found.

An execution-style shooting of a well-loved, self-made couple; early leads take police down a path of greed and desperation until a paper trail leads to a calculated betrayal shockingly close to home.

After a Texas mother is found murdered in an office bathroom, her husband admits a disturbing past while police chase down a serial killer; the case goes cold until an oversight leads to a surprise suspect and an FBI manhunt south of the border.

When a devoted mother vanishes from home, a series of grisly roadside discoveries take police on a hunt for a killer; detectives follow a path of greed and desperation until a shocking twist leads to a culprit with a bizarre motive.

When an outgoing college student is gunned down, police investigate disapproving roommates, a psychic and an infamous serial killer; decades-old evidence reveals a killer that original detectives had previously overlooked.
A mother of two disappears after a night out at a local bar in New Mexico; investigators race the clock in the hopes of finding her alive, and are eventually stunned by what they uncover.

A shooting in broad daylight in the city of Waterloo, Iowa leaves two dead; investigators Camarata and Moller follow a trail of bloody footprints to a list of suspects and an unexpected lead from a knowledgeable confidential informant.

Women are found brutally murdered and panic strikes Baton Rouge; the city suspects a serial killer is on the loose; in an example of police work at its finest, detectives lead investigators to an unlikely suspect hiding a dark secret.

East meets West when Rocky (Sylvester Stallone) takes on a vicious Soviet fighter (Dolph Lundgren) with a deadly punch in a match that means not only defending himself, but also defending the honor of his country and the memory of an old friend.

Broke and injured after his bout with Russian powerhouse Ivan Drago, Rocky Balboa (Sylvester Stallone) must rediscover his roots in this thrill-packed drama that reunites Stallone with John G. Avildsen, the Oscar®-winning director of 'Rocky.'

Sylvester Stallone is back in this action-packed sequel, and this time he's up against an opponent (Antonio Tarver) who's faster, stronger, and 30 years his junior! Milo Ventimiglia and Burt Young are ringside for the hard-hitting battle of the ages!

Adonis Johnson (Michael B Jordan) never knew his father, heavyweight champion Apollo Creed, who died before he was born.  But, with boxing in his blood, he heads to Philadelphia to convince the retired Rocky Balboa (Sylvester Stallone) to train him.

The next chapter in the Creed story follows Adonis Creed's life inside and outside the ring as he deals with newfound fame, family issues, and his ongoing quest to become a champion, with Michael B. Jordan and Sylvester Stallone starring.

After dominating the boxing world, Adonis Creed has been thriving in his career and family life.  But now he puts his future on the line to battle a fighter -- and former friend -- who has absolutely nothing to lose…and everything to gain.

As the boxer 'everyman' Rocky Balboa, Sylvester Stallone comes out swinging with heart, humor, and unforgettable power as he 'goes the distance' against World Heavyweight Champion Apollo Creed (Carl Weathers) in this unforgettable, Oscar®- winning film!

Sylvester Stallone, Carl Weathers, and Burgess Meredith return for the rematch of the century as Rocky takes on Apollo Creed, even though his doctors advise against it, in this blockbuster sequel that brought audiences to their feet!
When the enormous monster descends upon New York, it's up to the Army and an odd team of investigators to unravel the mystery behind the incredible creature before it's too late.
Sam Bell (Sam Rockwell) is nearing the completion of his 3-year-long contract with Lunar Industries, mining Earth's primary source of energy on the dark side of the moon.
As a result of a new medical technique, an agent is able to surgically take on the identical appearance of a criminal in order to take down his terrorist organization.

Bruce Willis, Milla Jovovich, and Gary Oldman star in acclaimed director Luc Besson's outrageous sci-fi adventure, an extravagantly styled tale of good against evil set in an unbelievable twenty-third-century world.

When a beautiful stranger leads computer hacker Neo to a forbidding underworld, he discovers the life he knows is the elaborate deception of an evil cyber-intelligence. Every second becomes a fight to stay alive - to escape The Matrix.

In the second chapter of the Matrix trilogy, Zion falls under siege by the Machine Army. Neo and Trinity choose to return to the Matrix with Morpheus. Now, Neo must follow the path he has chosen if he is to save humanity.

In this final chapter of the Matrix trilogy, Neo, Morpheus, and Trinity battle to defend Zion against the machines' onslaught that has enslaved the human race. And Neo faces the consequences of the choice made in The Matrix Reloaded.
Harrison Ford stars in this fascinating, dark vision of the near future as a policeman who tracks engineered humans — a Blade Runner.

Jeff Platt, the series' youngest CEO, goes undercover in his high-flying trampoline empire. How will the Boss react when one employee jumps to conclusions about his true identity? The Boss loses a spring in his step when tasked with building trampolines.
While undercover as an entry-level employee, the President and COO of Waste Management, Larry O'Donnell is fired for the first time in his career.

The highly anticipated opening of a New York Wahlburgers in Coney Island is stuck in last minute delays.  Not wanting to postpone the event, Donnie, Mark and Paul move forward with a public celebration all over the famous amusement park while battling.

Mark's friends are constantly looking to him for advice so when "Big A" lands a date of course he turns to Mark. Using some high tech audio gear, Mark is able to feed "Big A" lines during his lunch date. Back at Wahlburgers, Paul is stumped for a burger.
When Johnny Drama looks to take his music career to the next level, Mark suggests Drama make a music video that Mark himself will direct.

Mark flies to Philadelphia to host The Festival of Families to honor Pope Francis where Mark performs the emcee gig of a lifetime. Meanwhile, Alma, Paul and Bob attend the annual Wahlberg family reunion where Brandon gets his first chance to join poker.

Donnie promises to bring Wahlburgers to his Blue Bloods co-star Marisa Ramirez and the rest of the cast and crew.  Unfortunately, Mark sent Paul to Costa Rica for a much needed vacation.  Alma employs Brandon to help Donnie save face in front of his Blue.
Whenever New Kids on the Block perform in their hometown of Boston, it is a family event.

On a movie promotional tour in France, Mark invites Paul to Paris so the two of them can do some sightseeing as well as be together for Mark's birthday dinner. Of course, Mark also wants Paul to cook for him and his French-speaking actor friend.
Liquidating the contents of a restaurant should be easy – but the equipment is in such terrible condition Jeff can’t even recover his costs – until he tries a new tactic.
After receiving a load of rotten furniture, Jeff goes all the way to Indonesia in a bid to get his money back.
Jeff only has a few days in Indonesia to fill up a container of furniture, but his tough-guy negotiating style doesn’t fly with the locals.
Jeff's empire is growing, but when his second store's Grand Opening looks like it might end up being a bland opening.
Customer satisfaction isn't always guaranteed in this top ten episode of Customer Wars, especially if there are fists involved.
A woman vandalizes a New Jersey convenience store by randomly sweeping items off the shelves. A rideshare driver in Florida is pushed to the brink by a rude and unsanitary rider.
Customers brawl over an all you can eat crab legs buffet in Queens, NY. Trash talking between two groups of diners at a pancake house in Texas comes to blows.
A man in Florida attacks a fast food cashier apparently over a lack of available straws. A grounded passenger in Texas gets a serious comeuppance after slapping an airline employee.

Supermarket loss prevention officers try to wrangle an accused teenage shoplifter. The owner of a watch shop fights off two masked robbers. A woman attempting to buy alcohol at a pharmacy refuses to show her identification.
A delivery driver falls through a plate glass window at a New York pizza parlor. A concert goer in Toronto is accused of throwing a glass container at the stage and is set upon by the band.

Kevin Sheehan, President and CEO of Norwegian Cruise Line, finds himself in uncharted territory when he's asked to lead nearly 1,000 party-goers in a line dance, and is later forced to reveal his true identity after being recognized by an employee.

Ronald Croatti, President and CEO of UniFirst, one of the nation's largest producers of workwear and uniforms, dons a "hippie" look during his undercover mission, where he finds himself struggling to keep pace with the fast-moving assembly line.

Sheldon Yellen, the CEO of BELFOR, the world's largest disaster restoration company, goes undercover and becomes frustrated while struggling to hang drywall. Also, the boss unexpectedly reveals himself while working alongside an employee.

Paul wants his son to be a father someday but is unhappy when Bogart brings a “practice baby” to an auction. Ursula finds out if blondes do have more fun. Rick and Cindy try silent but deadly tactics and no one notices when Roy is more honest.

programmes.st: The Birds And The Bees And The Bulls
programmes.d: The buyers learn lessons at an auction in Ontario. Paul and Bogart discover that listening to each other is useless. Glasses affect Ursula's bidding. Roy learns that his true calling is a frat boy and Rick and Cindy get too much information.

Ursula goes ape at an auction when Roy says her coat makes her look like a monkey. Paul and Bogart set a bad example for returning buyer Jeff Gardner and his son. It takes a lot for Rick and Cindy to bid on their locker and Roy's out for blood.

Roy brings noisemakers to an auction in Emery Village but the other buyers aren't feeling it. Rick and Cindy prefer to clown around on their own time. Paul and Bogart boogie with some intergalactic performers, and all Ursula wants is a strong coffee.

programmes.st: May The Schwarz Be With You
programmes.d: Jeff Schwarz, aka “The Liquidator,” is back and is causing as much chaos as possible.

Mikey Saber (a magnetic Simon Rex) — a charismatic con man and washed-up porn star — plots his return to the big time from small-town Texas in this wild, fiercely funny portrait of an American hustler and a hometown that barely tolerates him.
A housewife from the suburbs and her closest companion transform a pastime into an elaborate operation involving counterfeit coupons, resulting in millions of dollars.
After blowing a date with Gary (Pete Davidson), Sheila (Kaley Cuoco) discovers a time machine & loops back to fix everything.

Sean Penn directs and stars along side his daughter Dylan Penn in this intimate family portrait of a young woman who struggles to reconcile her memories of her loving father with the fact that he was the most notorious counterfeiter in U.S. history.

Jonathan Majors (Creed III) and Glen Powell (Top Gun: Maverick) star in the epic and inspirational true story of two elite US fighter pilots during the Korean War. Their heroic sacrifices would ultimately make them the Navy's most celebrated wingmen.
A housewife from the suburbs and her closest companion transform a pastime into an elaborate operation involving counterfeit coupons, resulting in millions of dollars.

Evan McCauley has skills he never learned and memories of places he has never visited. Self-medicated and on the brink of a mental breakdown, a secret group that call themselves Infinites come to his rescue, revealing that his memories are real.

Six divas of the silver screen - Sally Field, Dolly Parton, Shirley MacLaine, Daryl Hannah, Olympia Dukakis, and Julia Roberts - come together as bosom buddies in this hilarious and heartwarming story of life, love, and loss in a small Louisiana parish.
Patrick Swayze and Jennifer Grey star in this spirit-lifting story about a summer love affair between a naïve 17-year-old girl and a charismatic dance instructor at a Catskills hotel. Rated PG-13

Join the Club - The First Wives Club, the good-time battle-of-the-sexes satire sparked by snappy one-liners, great physical-comedy gags, and three unforgettable stars in top form, Bette Midler, Goldie Hawn, and Diane Keaton.
Loner Zack Mayo (Richard Gere) enters Officer Candidate School to become a Navy pilot, and in thirteen torturous weeks, he learns the importance of discipline, love, and friendship.
Julia Roberts and Richard Gere star in an irresistible comedy hit.
Steve Martin turns in a heartwarming and hilarious performance.

As Harry Burns and Sally Albright build their lives and careers in Manhattan, their paths continue to cross, and their friendship continues to grow … until they confront the decision whether to let their friendship develop into romance.
Seeking retribution, Louis lashes out at the Parisian rebels though Philippe urges a more reasoned response.
Can Louis' longed-for loving touch help the ailing queen?
Louis hopes diplomacy will hide his duplicity as he works to undermine Leopold.
Has Louis finally learnt the identity of the man in the iron mask?

Aramis and d'Artagnan are thwarted in their task to transport a young woman and her baby from a village outside Paris to the Palace when armed men abduct her baby. They must find out who she is and why anyone would go to such lengths to kidnap her son.

Following the death of a young girl, The Musketeers' investigation into her missing friend leads them to the world of a high-born woman. They put aside their animosity towards Cardinal when his life is placed in danger and rescue this extraordinary woman.

Fed up with the rivalry between the Musketeers and the Red Guards, the King calls a contest between them to settle which one is stronger once and for all. D'Artagnan is determined to be chosen to fight so he can prove himself worthy to be a Musketeer.

The Musketeers come under siege in a convent whilst protecting the Queen after an attempt is made on her life by a crack-shot assassin. Fearful for their lives the Mother Superior and nuns help the Musketeers to defend the convent.

An unexpected rift between the Musketeers threatens to blow them apart. The Cardinal, fearful the Musketeers will prove he masterminded the attempt on the Queen's life, compels Milady to kill them by any means.

The Musketeers are sent to retrieve the Comte de Rochefort, the Cardinal's man in Madrid who has escaped from a Spanish Prison and brings news that the chief author of France's military strategy against Spain, General De Foix, has been captured.

Mary risks everything to take down Condé, even as Francis believes she is turning against France. Catherine makes a bold move and meets with Queen Elizabeth (guest star Rachel Skarsten) in a stunning plot to seek revenge on Mary.
Queen Mary struggles to hold on to her power in Scotland amidst Queen Elizabeth's campaign to sabotage her with the help of a new ally in Queen Catherine.

Elizabeth must deal with the political backlash of harboring Catherine in England, while Catherine is imprisoned upon her return to France. Mary is forced to make some difficult decisions about securing Scotland's future.
When King Antoine unexpectedly returns to Court, Mary must help Francis hide his weakening condition long enough to secure his family's future.

After Mary receives an urgent message from her ailing mother about the dire situation in Scotland, she finds herself looking to Francis for aid. Catherine finds herself up against Narcisse as she fights to become the regent to Charles.
In the fifth and final season premiere, Peter and his daughter Etta (GEORGINA HAIG) set out to find out what happened to Olivia.
The Fringe team revisits Walter's Harvard lab — now under Observer control — to locate information they need to fight on in their mission to save the world.
As the Fringe team continues to fight the Observers, unforeseen events lead them into a forest, where they encounter a strange subculture devoted to recording human history.

programmes.st: The Bullet That Saved the World
programmes.d: When the Fringe Team tracks a lead into a hostile and heavily guarded location, Phillip Broyles (series star LANCE REDDICK) resurfaces… but can he be trusted?
The Fringe Team goes on the offensive.

programmes.st: Through the Looking Glass And What Walter Found There
programmes.d: A key piece needed to defeat the Observers is uncovered.
The Fringe Team orchestrates a Fringe event of their own.
While Olivia encounters an intuitive oracle-like person (guest star JILL SCOTT) on a mission for Walter, Peter finds himself in a perilous situation as he observes Windmark.

programmes.st: Eternal Sunshine of the Caffeinated Mind
programmes.d: When an incredibly optimistic coffee-shop owner is murdered, Liv uses her sunny outlook to help Clive solve the murder. GREG FINLEY, ENRICO COLANTONI guest star.
Blaine pays Ravi a visit at the morgue, and Liv discovers something new about Drake (GREG FINLEY). Plus, Vaughn du Clark (STEVEN WEBER) confronts Major.
Liv consumes the brain of a recently murdered stripper. Major and Ravi are helping Peyton (ALY MICHALKA) move back in with Liv when she receives a surprising phone call.

programmes.st: Reflections of the Way Liv Used to Be
programmes.d: After consuming the brain of a type-A, ambitious and competitive student near the top of her class, Liv becomes very much like the girl she was before becoming a zombie.
Liv and Ravi find an unlikely ally in Blaine. Meanwhile, when Major finds himself in a world of trouble, sleazebag Brant Stone (KEN MARINO) comes to his rescue.
Season finale: Working together, Liv, Detective Babineaux and Major crash Vaughn's (STEVEN WEBER) Super Max Rager party, where singer ROB THOMAS (Matchbox 20) performs.

programmes.st: Heaven Just Got a Little Bit Smoother
programmes.d: Liv has discovered there is a private military contractor employing a small zombie army, Major lands a job with the only place that will hire him and Blaine is accused of lying.
Liv, Clive, and Ravi investigate a fatal car accident. Clive is brought in for questioning about a family that was murdered, forcing him to reveal his past history with them.
Trying to recall his plan, Walter takes an LSD trip down memory lane.  Meanwhile, Peter and Olivia trace a mysterious signal into the woods, where they come upon a grisly scene.
Japan is going through a seismic crisis after the devastating Tsunami of 2011. We look closely at two very dangerous volcanoes; both are considered to be in the top 5 most dangerous on the planet.

programmes.st: In the Path of a Volcano
programmes.d: For people who live on active volcanoes, life has an element of impermanence to it. There is always the fear that one day their turn will come, and their home will be in the path of the volcano.
Philippe Cousteau explores the cause of volcanoes, earthquakes and tsunamis.
Philippe uncovers how we could face extinction, including Yellowstone's super volcano, and asteroids
Philippe Cousteau visits various ecosystems around the country, including Yellowstone National Park.
Philippe Cousteau explores some of our planets most extreme weather and the latest weather research.
Philippe Cousteau explores the incredible world of plants.
Philippe Cousteau explores the icy and fiery parts of our world.
Philippe Cousteau explores how our planet evolved through dinosaur fossils and unique geology.
Philippe Cousteau explores underwater environments across the country.

Explore the tallest towers, the biggest palaces, the grandest tombs and ancient temples that were forgotten for centuries. This episode shows how technique, technology, and ambition have developed some of the most magnificent structures in the world.
The human race is constantly looking for a better way to get from point A to point B. From tall ships to the invention of the automobile, travel has always been a necessity.

People have labored on some gigantic undertakings such as roads, bridges, and canals that link oceans. These feats of engineering have allowed cities to grow, but now they are also allowing us to travel into space.
For as long as man has been alive, he has fought to defend what is rightfully his and fought even harder to take what is not. He soon figured out, the man with the biggest weapon has the advantage.
Discovering the transport networks of the past.
Examining the history of the Great Wall of China.
Exploring how ancient Egyptian engineers built the monumental Great Pyramid at Giza.
In the Middle Ages, the technology of the castle evolved by leaps and bounds.

Saturn is the second-largest planet in the solar system. Storms on this gas giant can cover an area bigger than the United States Clouds of the gas race around the planet at over 1000 miles per hour generating fierce electrical storms and lightning.

programmes.st: The Big Bang - The First Three Seconds
programmes.d: 13.7 billion years ago there was absolutely nothing. No space, no time, and no matter. Naked Science follows the first three seconds of creation when a speck of light appeared from nothing and rapidly expanded into an enormous Universe.
DOUBLE FEATURE FRIDAY: A professional hitman faces a group of assassins after the boss of a crime syndicate suspects disloyalty due to his attendance at Workaholics Anonymous meetings.

This epic drama chronicles J.G. Ballard's remarkable struggle to survive a childhood marked by betrayal, death, and disappointment, while trapped in Shanghai during the Japanese occupation of World War II.

Get ready for thrills in Indiana Jones and the Raiders of the Lost Ark. Indy and his ex-flame Marion Ravenwood dodge booby-traps, fight Nazis, and stare down snakes in their incredible worldwide quest for the mystical Ark of the Covenant.

programmes.t: Indiana Jones and the Temple of Doom
programmes.d: Indiana Jones and the Temple of Doom brings you thrills and excitement. Indy, his sidekick Short Round, and nightclub singer Willie Scott go from high-flying action above the Himalayas to a spine-tingling escape from a fortress-like mine in India.

programmes.t: Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade
programmes.d: There's nothing more exciting than trying to keep up with the Joneses in Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade. Indy's Nazi enemies are back and have kidnapped his father in their effort to locate the sacred Holy Grail.

programmes.t: Indiana Jones and the Kingdom of the Crystal Skull
programmes.d: STEVEN SPIELBERG and GEORGE LUCAS present Indiana Jones and the Kingdom of the Crystal Skull. Join Indy as he races against a brilliant and beautiful agent for the mystical, all-powerful crystal skull of Akator in this thrilling adventure!
Brendan Fraser and Rachel Weisz star in this nonstop action epic about the discovery of a long-lost treasure in the Egyptian desert that also unearths a 3,000-year-old legacy of terror!
Colonel Terry Childers is a patriot and war hero. But when a peacekeeping mission he leads in Yemen goes terribly wrong, he finds himself facing a court-martial.

Winner of four Academy Awards, including Best Picture, filmmakers Joel and Ethan Coen (FARGO) bring to the screen a thrilling bestseller in which a crime-scene's irresistible stolen loot sets forth an unstoppable chain reaction of violence.
Upon his release from prison, an extremely volatile and dangerous ex-con travels from England to Los Angeles to find the man he considers responsible for his estranged daughter's "accidental" death.

In a gym bag. That's how three men size up what they've found in the snowy Minnesota woods. They've come across a downed plane with a rotting corpse inside...and over $4 million stuffed inside a duffel bag. Finders, keepers? Maybe.

Lifelong friends begin experiencing the "night terrors" that plagued them as children, convincing them that a supernatural force is pursuing them.

Master of horror Wes Craven presents a sexy, modern-day adaptation of the classic Gothic thriller.  After Dracula is awakened from his 100-year slumber, he makes America his first destination, specifically the exotic city of New Orleans.

It is Christmas Eve and the Harringtons take a trip to their in-laws to celebrate the holidays. Taking an unfamiliar shortcut, Mr. Harrington makes the biggest mistake of his life and leads his family down a terror-filled road with no end.

The pastor (Ethan Hawke) of a small church in upstate New York spirals out of control after a soul-shaking encounter with an unstable environmental activist and his pregnant wife (Amanda Seyfried) in this taut, chilling thriller.

programmes.t: Before The Devil Knows You're Dead
programmes.d: Andy, an overextended payroll executive, lures his younger brother, Hank, into a larcenous scheme: the pair will rob a suburban mom-and-pop jewelry store that appears to be the quintessential easy target.
A black ops agent (John Cusack) and a code operator (Malin Akerman) in a remote CIA broadcast station find themselves in a life-or-death struggle to stop a deadly plot before it's too late.
A globetrotting hitman and a salesman form an unlikely relationship after meeting at a hotel bar in Mexico City.

For his final assignment, a top temporal agent must pursue the one criminal that has eluded him throughout time. The chase becomes a unique, surprising, and mind-bending exploration of love, fate, identity, and time-travel taboos.

A murder in the Louvre and clues in Da Vinci's paintings lead to the discovery of a religious mystery protected by a secret society for two thousand years -- one that could shake the foundations of Christianity.
Expert symbologist Robert Langdon (Tom Hanks) follows ancient clues on a heart-racing hunt through Rome to find the four Cardinals kidnapped by the deadly secret society, the Illuminati.

Gluttony, greed, sloth, envy, wrath, pride, lust—everyone has a sin. Detectives William Somerset and David Mills live among these sins every day. But nothing can prepare them for the killings they're about to experience.
A detached man and his friend organize brutal, bare-knuckle boxing matches.
Leonardo DiCaprio and Oscar-nominee Kate Winslet light up the screen as Jack and Rose, the young lovers who find one another on the maiden voyage of the "unsinkable" R.M.S. Titanic.

From director Michael Bay and executive producer Steven Spielberg comes a thrilling battle between the heroic Autobots and the evil Decepticons. When their epic struggle comes to Earth, Sam Witwicky becomes mankind's last chance for survival.
The battle for Earth continues when college-bound Sam Witwicky learns the truth about the ancient origins of the Transformers and must join in their continued battle against the Decepticons.

A mysterious event from Earth's past threatens to ignite a war so big that the Transformers alone will not be able to save the planet. Sam Witwicky and the Autobots must fight against the darkness to defend our world from the Decepticons.

When a woman is gunned down in the parking lot of her therapist’s office building, it looks like a random act of violence.
The search for an adored local businesswoman who vanished without a trace quickly morphs into a homicide investigation after police discover microscopic evidence inside the woman’s home and car.
Cops investigate the apparent carjacking of a husband and wife in East Los Angeles, California only to discover that the ambush was a ruse, carried out by cousins.
A central California community is rocked when a pregnant wife vanishes without a trace on Christmas Eve.
A dedicated mother disappears from suburban Los Angeles, leaving behind three kids and a husband she planned to divorce.
When a Southern California high school teacher suddenly dies, it appears his death was due to natural causes.
When a chef’s wife goes missing from Southern California, it initially appears she may have voluntarily walked away from the life she knew.
For one week in 2016, Stefano Brizzi stored the body of a policeman in his flat in central London. Taking inspiration from the TV show Breaking Bad, he tried to dissolve the body in his bath tub.
On July 1st, 2000, eight-year-old Sarah Payne was snatched from the street in Littlehampton, West Sussex. She had been abducted and murdered by convicted paedophile Roy Whiting.
On December 1st, 1996, Tracie Andrews had stabbed her own fiancé Lee Harvey to death and was trying to get away with murder.
In 1988, Puente had drugged and killed her victims so she could continue to fraudulently claim their social security benefits.
Rodney Alcala appeared on The Dating Game and it led to his arrest. In 2011, he was found guilty of murdering six women and a twelve-year-old girl.
The murder of a beloved yoga instructor appears to be an open and shut robbery homicide until detectives find themselves deep in a murder investigation with one too many twists.
When a real estate entrepreneur is found in a pool of blood in his ransacked kitchen, investigators suspect a long-simmering family feud may be connected to his murder.
Five university students are brutally attacked and killed. As officers meticulously investigate the death scenes, they realize this is no average murderer. This killer knows how to cover his tracks.

In one violent evening, a series of bombs rock the sleepy California city of Fremont. The targets include both the Chief and Ex-Chief of police. Can authorities and forensic scientists stop the Fremont Bomber before he strikes again?
In August 1985, the fourteen-month killing spree of Richard Ramirez, known as the 'Night Stalker,' was ended after he claimed at least thirteen lives.
Serial killing partners Leonard Lake and Charles Ng murdered eleven people in California in the 1980s. They had a secret bunker where they raped and killed their prey.
The Sunderland Strangler, Steven Grieveson, killed four teenage boys in the early 90s.
Vince is a seasoned New Orleans sportscaster, and his marriage to the much younger Liz looks like a second chance for them both.

Lee Van Cleef and  John Phillip Law star in this bona fide Spaghetti Western classic as, fifteen years after bandits massacred his family, a young man seeking revenge forms an unlikely alliance with the outlaw who was framed for the murders.
A Michigan farmer and a prospector form a partnership in the California gold country. Their adventures include buying and sharing a wife...
The cantankerous Rooster is hired by a headstrong young girl (Kim Darby) to find the man who murdered her father and fled with the family savings.
