Stiles tries to prove his suspicions about a new classmate while Lydia helps a student with night terrors.
Scott tracks a dangerous new shapeshifter threatening Stilinski. Malia receives information about her mother’s identity.
Stiles tries to track down a fugitive. Liam tries to play wingman to Mason at a nightclub.
The Pack goes into Eichen House to learn more about The Dread Doctors.
Scott and his friends experience strange effects after following Dr. Valack’s advice.
Scott’s plan to protect the newest victim goes awry when The Dread Doctors attack.
Scott and Malia attempt to rescue their captured friends. Deaton makes a horrific discovery about The Dread Doctors.
While Scott turns to an unlikely ally for help, Stiles and Lydia try to uncover the truth about Parrish.
Scott and his pack face their greatest enemy yet, with both lives and friendships on the verge of being destroyed.
Scott and Stiles must strive to figure out what's behind the mysterious infection that's killing the town sheriff in spite of their deep rift.
Without the support of his pack, Scott confronts what the Dread Doctors' deadly success means for Beacon Hills.
Kira and her mother take extreme measures to help Kira deal with her dark side while Lydia is surprised at Eichen House.
As Scott tries to put his pack back together, Malia and a new ally set out to rescue Deaton from The Desert Wolf.
After discovering Lydia is in imminent danger, Stiles creates a desperate plan to break her out of Eichen House. Unbeknownst to Scott and his pack, however, Theo has his own plans for Lydia.
Trapped in Eichen House with Theo and his Chimera Pack, Scott must try to rescue Lydia before it’s too late.
Scott and his pack use a charity lacrosse game in a deadly gambit to figure out the identity of the Beast.
Hoping to align with a familiar ally, the Argents reveal a key clue to the mystery of the Beast of Gevaudan.  Meanwhile, Scott tries to take on the Beast himself.
With the identity of the Beast finally revealed, Scott and his friends are in a race against time to stop the Dread Doctors from implementing their final plan.
Loyalties are tested and new alliances forged as Scott and his friends work to stop the Beast before Beacon Hills is razed to the ground.
With graduation approaching, a supernatural force rides into Beacon Hills and crosses paths with Scott and his friends, while Liam discovers evidence of a new enemy in the high school.
While Scott, Lydia and Malia search for lost memories of a missing friend, Corey discovers a connection between his abilities and the Wild Hunt.
While Scott, Lydia and Malia search for Stiles, Liam and the others throw a party to keep a friend safe from the Ghost Riders.
Scott and Liam protect the lacrosse team from an attack by the Ghost Riders while Lydia searches for clues that lead her closer to finding Stiles.
Trapped inside the Wild Hunt, Stiles reunites with an unexpected ally while Scott, Lydia and Malia discover Stiles’s Jeep may be connected to his disappearance.
Scott, Lydia and Malia search for clues about the Wild Hunt in a mysterious place called Canaan while Liam and Hayden resort to drastic measures in the fight against the Ghost Riders.
Scott and Liam attempt to capture a Ghost Rider while Malia and Peter search for a way into the Wild Hunt.
Running out of time, Scott, Lydia and Malia decide to storm the rift in a desperate attempt to get Stiles back. Liam, Hayden and Mason make a deal with Theo in order to learn Douglas's real plan.
While Liam and Theo act as decoys, Scott, Lydia and Malia enact a desperate plan to try and remember Stiles.
With the fate of Beacon Hills hanging in the balance, Scott and his pack face off against Douglas in a final showdown.
As Scott readies Beacon Hills for his imminent departure, a mysterious presence breaks out of Eichen House.
Scott and Malia search for the owner of a unique bullet, fearing that a new breed of werewolf hunter has come to Beacon Hills. At the same time, Lydia must face her own fears of Eichen House.
While Scott and the others desperately pursue a missing werewolf, Melissa and Argent investigate the nature of a strange body.
Scott, Lydia and Malia have to take drastic measures to quell the growing violence in Beacon Hills, while Liam endures his own gauntlet at the high school.

Ann and Donald decide to work on a play about her life, but creative differences get in the way.
Ann's movie role calls for a nude scene.
Ann struggles to cook everybody's favorite dishes for a Thanksgiving dinner.
A substitute agent sets Ann up on a publicity date with Dick Shawn, who knows nothing about it.
Ann is offered a high-fashion modeling assignment that means a trip to California.
Ann and a bachelor photographer make headlines that bring Don out to Hollywood from New York.
Ann buys theater tickets from a scalper as a Christmas present for the Baumans.
After Ann is injured on a movie set, Donald goes overboard in trying to take care of her.
After Ann models an expensive chinchilla stole, the owner insists that she borrow it.
Another family visit to Ann's parents in Brewster pits Donald against Lou.
Lou Marie buys theater and train tickets for sixty-five people from Brewster to see Ann in a play.
A commercial director tells Anne she has a face that no housewife would feel threatened by.
Ann suggests that her father escort Ethel Merman to a formal event.
Still obsessed with Ann, Noel Prince returns to New York to try to get her to marry him.
A scandal erupts when Donald's mother is invited to Ann's place and finds his pants in her closet.
Friend's athletic prowess admired.
A series of obscene phone calls prompts Ann to call the NYPD, who sends over a detective.
Injured Ann mistakes a doctor for Don.
Ann hires press agent Eddie Edwards to boost her career.
After a hunting trip, Donald decides to grow a beard, which doesn't necessarily turn Ann on.
Ann helps sober up a comedian who thinks that they had an affair.
An elderly man who ruins Ann's dress gets her a new one, but he keeps buying her gifts.
Ann must slap Barry Sullivan onstage.
Ann's flight to Florida is hijacked.
Ann is selected for jury duty.
Don and Ann head to Hollywood.
Ann's commercial work proves to be more grueling than she could possibly have expected.
Ann takes her responsibility to vote so seriously that it gets her into a spat with her father.
Ann gets stuck in the shower and the new neighbor comes to her rescue.
Don researches the NYPD's mugger detail.
Reuniting the feuding Baumans.
Middle-aged aristocrat wants to wed Don.
Ann is jealous of Don's secretary.
The Screen Actors Guild gives Ann a huge paycheck, and she struggles with what to do with it.
Dinner becomes a loud bash.
Woman thinks husband loves Ann.
Donald buys Ann a small avant-garde sculpture and gets plenty of advice on what to do with it.
While watching her parents house in Brewster, Ann gets locked in the basement.
Ann loses an earring Don gave her.
Ann is faced with a sudden audit from the IRS.
Ann plans a spectacular career for a woman who dubbed her voice in a commercial.
Ann swallows her pride for a TV role.
A stray dog that follow Ann home decides to bite her visiting father.
While shopping, Ann becomes sympathetic to an eight-year-old boy who tries to steal a candy bar.
The United States Air Force hires Ann to recruit women to the WAFS for potential space travel.
Ann's father suspects the worst when he finds Don in Ann's apartment early one morning.
Ann's father turns a rainy-day game of Monopoly into a family crisis.
Ann's father slips and hurts himself, and Donald has to get him to sign an insurance waiver.
While modeling, Ann is hired to spy on a competitor who is suspected of stealing designs.
Ann's cover is blown and she is tricked into photographing rejected dress designs.
Lou wants Ann to direct a variety show.
Ann lands a job as a dancing chicken for a restaurant; she gets stranded on a country road.
Under hypnosis at the dentist, Ann is mistakenly told to buy anything at the drop of a hat.
Ann loses her hearing when a cold ruins her job on a commercial.
Snow traps Ann, her parents and Don.
Don writes a comedy sketch about their previous adventures being stranded at JFK Airport.
Don is doing a story on a fighter who has developed an acting bug.
An old boyfriend of Ann's becomes the owner of her apartment building.
Donald has a chance to get a job in Paris and worries about leaving Ann.
Ann gets a job in Las Vegas with an actor who wants her to break up with Donald.
While in Las Vegas, Donald is tricked into thinking that he married a showgirl.
Ann tries to impress Donald's never-married ex-girlfriend.
Ann Marie is trying comedy with a group in the Catskills.
Ann dreads bad reviews of her opening night on Broadway.
Ann recalls her high-school days as a meter maid, when she ticketed the mayor's car.
While flying to a cabin, Ann, Donald and their pilot land in a snow storm after they run out of gas.
Ann and Don find a cabin after their plane crashes and leaves them lost in the woods.
Ann gets a card from a stockbroker and invests in the list of items on the back.
Ann's father hires a musical group to increase business at his restaurant.
As class treasurer, Ann loses $360 that was saved for their reunion. Ann looks for the thieves.
Ann has to go to court to help a producer win a lawsuit involving a shish-kebab skewer.
Ann sees her neighbor Ruthie kissing another man.

Thorne reveals his feelings to Caroline. Eric asks Stephanie if she wants a divorce.

Dave tells Brooke the police caught Grandma Logan’s muggers. Mark tells Rocco to leave Donna alone.
Caroline asks Ridge who he slept with before the wedding. Ridge doesn’t want to say.
Brooke and Storm prepare for their graduation ceremonies. Donna tells Katie she doesn’t want to go to college.
Storm asks Alex to dinner. She decides to cancel her plans with Thorne. Eric finally realizes who Beth is.
Caroline recognizes Brooke and suggests they get together sometime. Eric approaches Beth and they speak.
Donna tells Katie she feels trapped at home. Brooke tells Beth she finds Ridge fascinating.
Donna tells Katie about her plan to move out. Rocco tells Katie to tell the family for Donna’s sake.
Thorne accuses Stephanie of favoring Ridge. Donna tells her family she is moving out.
Caroline calls Brooke and they agree to meet. Ridge is upset to learn Alex interviews both Thorne and Eric.
Stephanie asks Caroline to set Kristen up with eligible men. Ridge is upset that Thorne went behind his back.
Bill wants Thorne to take over if he marries Caroline. Brooke and Caroline get to know each other.
Rocco defends Katie against bullies and gives her a big kiss. Kristen asks Eric about his college sweetheart.
Rocco tells Donna to dump Mark and move home. Stephanie is suspicious when Eric leaves for his date with Beth.
Eric tells Beth he left her because Stephanie got pregnant. Brooke is happy to play tennis at the Forrester's.
Thorne is uncomfortable about being set up with Brooke. Stephanie suspects Eric is being unfaithful.
Eric tells Margo about his meeting with Beth. Brooke invites Caroline over the same night Storm invites Alex.
Ridge is shocked to hear Thorne has been offered another job. Bill comforts Margo about Eric.
Brooke tries to set Storm up with Caroline but Storm says he is with Alex. Katie and Rocco go to visit Donna.

Thorne and Kristen try to find out who Eric is seeing. Kristen is surprised her parents' marriage has lasted.
Donna is fired, she and Mark get into a fight. Margo tells Ridge Eric is involved with someone from college.
Ridge asks Thorne about his job offer. Beth tells Stephanie someone else will supervise Eric’s party.
Donna is thankful when Rocco gets her a job. Beth won’t see Eric anymore because Stephanie loves him.
Mark is angry to learn Donna will be working with Rocco. Rocco rescues Ridge and Caroline from a mugging.
Eric asks Stephanie to cancel the birthday party. Caroline decides to set Kristen up with her boss.
Bill meets Alex and finds out where she is staying. Caroline tells Stephanie about Ridge pressuring her.
Ridge tries to seduce Margo. Donna apologizes to Rocco. Kristen enjoys her blind date with Chuck.
Katie thanks Rocco for helping her skin clear up. Ridge tries to seduce Brooke and invites her to swim.

Dr. Eberhardt (Ralph Macchio) discovers a way for comatose patients to communicate with each other by interfacing with a computer. But when he hooks himself up to the machine, he discovers a cyberspace "paradise" he may never be able to leave!

Cliff Robertson -- who starred in the very first episode of the classic series -- returns to the Outer Limits as an aging astronaut whose 1963 mission was a career-ending disaster. If he can just get back to space, perhaps he can clear his name.

Like other Star Fleet vessels, Ship (voice of Malcolm McDowell) has evolved and now controls the only human (Jack Noseworthy) aboard. But the relationship takes a dramatic turn when Man meets Woman and fights machine in a desperate bid for freedom!

Do our memories define our identity? If we are merely the sum of our experiences, what do we become if those experiences are lost? Hope Wilson (Robbie Chong) faces this question when she meets a man who has purposely erased his own memories.

Courtesy of a freak accident (and The Outer Limits), an agoraphobe (Jane Adams) begins to hear the private thoughts of all of the tenants in her building...the good, the bad and the steamy. And it seems at least one of them may want to kill her.

A scientist -- who is also a religious zealot (David Ogden Stiers) -- secretly implants an embryo created with DNA from the Shroud of Turin into a young woman (Samantha Mathis) in order to scientifically engineer the Second Coming of Christ.

The Outer Limits come to Victorian Whitechapel when a London doctor (Cary Elwes) races to capture the alien creature responsible for the Jack the Ripper murders. But when the alien frames the good doctor for the murders, his time may be up.

The son (Saul Rubinek) of a concentration camp survivor (Peter Boretski) gets some unique help in proving the guilt of a former Nazi (Jan Rubes) living in the U.S....courtesy of a time traveler (Alex Daikun) and, of course, The Outer Limits.

The planets Earth and Dregocia struggle to re-establish a fragile trust after a summit goes tragically wrong. Can a diplomat (Marcia Cross) calm the hawkish nature of both species…and can she overcome her own prejudices to save both worlds?

A meek anthropologist (Leland Orser) develops a serum for genetic dominance and tests it on himself. Now his newfound confidence takes complete control of him, turning him into an irrational, overly aggressive troglodyte! Can he reverse the process?

The Haven is a high-tech apartment building which is run by supercomputer and almost completely eliminates the need for human contact. But when things begin to go wrong, neighbors who have never met must learn to work together in order to survive!

When a scientist's (Kevin Nealon) experiment unintentionally creates a rift in the space-time continuum, he suddenly find himself caught in a time loop and soon begins to suspects sabotage. Terri Hawkes, Jennifer Copping and Ronny Cox also star.

A boy (Adam Hann-Byrd) , picked on by high-school bullies and neglected by his own father (Daniel Hugh Kelley), finds comfort in an alien (Chris Potter) who has crash-landed on earth. But is the alien what he claims to be? Never…in The Outer Limits.

In a world dominated by alien invaders, a cynical American cafe owner (Nathan Fillion) must decide if he will risk his life to help an old lover fight for Earth or if he is happy not rocking the political boat. Derek de Lint also stars.

When Detective Terry Russo (Megan Gallagher) is called to investigate a double murder, she discovers she may be solving not one crime, but possibly hundreds. And that the culprit -- or culprits -- may not be human at all. Michael Riley also stars.

A convicted murderer is turned loose only to be hunted by the sister of his victim as part the hottest show on television, Judgment Day, which allows the family members -- and the at home audience -- to act as judge, jury and executioner!

An ex-con who had been serving time for spousal abuse is bent on revenge against his wife. He purchases a strange handgun from a gun dealer and finds this is no ordinary weapon and, in fact, he becomes quite attached to it…literally.

A device that allows people to change their appearance helps a nerdy guy become the mirror image of his hunky co-worker.. Now arrogant with his new-found good looks, the former nerd experiences a life like never before…and now he wants to keep it.

An invisible alien race that inhabits the energy systems of a deserted spaceship envelopes the crew of a salvage team, responding to the empty vessel's distress signal, in a web of paranoia, suspicion and murder. Michael Shanks stars.

When a scientist uses his time machine to travel into the future, he discovers his wife lying dead in a pool of blood and a man fleeing the scene. Determined save her, he uses the time machine to go back in time...but is her death inevitable?

A blind man (Mackenzie Astin) regains his sight only to be used by the government for his unique ability to see an alien from another dimension who has been trapped on Earth and yearns to return home. But the government has other plans for her.

A veterinarian (Jessica Tuck) in a small farming community becomes alarmed when a genetically-engineered corn seed, intended to produce faster, larger yields of corn, produces something far more alarming …human mutations! Len Cariou also stars.

After losing his wife and son in a horrific car accident some twenty years earlier, a scientist (Joel Gray) uses advanced technology to build the perfect robotic version of his son. But perfection is not always so perfect...in The Outer Limits.

Due to dwindling resources in the future, the world consists of "Alphas" and "Betas" who are alternately put in stasis for 72 hour periods, all in service to the "Elites," who lord over the Alphas and the Betas...But a resistance is coming.

When a man arrives at al UFO convention with part of an alien ship, it throws the annual gathering of "true believers" into chaos and leads to a conspiracy, a cover-upï¿½and murder. But who is conspiring with whom? And what are they covering up?

After being brought back from death, a woman (Laura Leighton) discovers she was one part of a pair of conjoined twins, the other lost during pregnancy. And now that twin, living dormant in her body for all these years, wants a life of her own.

Tom (Tate Donovan) and Wendy (Gabrielle Miller) are the perfect couple, happy and very much in love. But at night, Tom has terrible memory flashes about being stuck in a burning building The nightmares, however, aren't real…and neither is Tom.

After the plane he is traveling in is struck by lightning, a Presidential candidate is visited by a time traveler who tells him that he needs to escape impending death because his presidency is the key to preventing an apocalyptic future.

The crew of a space salvage ship is awakened from hyper-sleep when they come across a mysterious object floating through space. They soon discover the pod contains a tyrant, in stasis, who was banished from Earth for crimes against humanity.

A man travels back to his home town in order to investigate his brother's murder, allegedly at the hands of his brother's wife. He quickly discovers his hometown has drastically changed...and the residents seem to be under some form of mind control.

A preacher (Gary Busey), who lost his faith when his wife died, performs staged healing miracles at tent revivals until he finds his faith -- and livelihood -- being tested as never before by the appearance of a mysterious wheelchair-bound man.

Two friends re-enacting the Battle of Gettysburg unwittingly find themselves transported back in time and taken prisoner by a deranged Confederate colonel (Meatloaf) who might not only endanger their future…but the future of the country as well.

A teenage boy (Joseph Gordon-Levitt) suspects that the tenant (Judd Nelson) now taking up residence in his mother's backyard apartment is actually an alien on a deadly mission…a suspicion that puts the boy and his mother in grave danger.

An anarchist (Frank Whaley), who was once rabidly pro-technology, threatens to blow up the central computers that control the world. As he negotiates with Pete Yastremski (John Amos) to surrender, we discover what led him down this dark path.

When the leader of an Arctic exploration team kills two colleagues, psychologist Jack Burrell (William Cummins) is sent up to counsel the staff, including an old "friend" (Robert Sean Leonard), and to find the cause of an infectious psychosis.

Time-traveler Dr. Theresa Givens (Amanda Plummer) faces the death penalty for using her time machine in a future where all technology is banned due to a devastating nuclear holocaust some 20 years earlier. Charlton Heston also stars.

An overworked father who wants to relieve the tension in his home due to the demands of his job orders a robot to keep house and perform other chores. Much to the father's surprise, the robot starts to replace him as head of the household.

A military colonel travels into the past from a plagued-ridden future where billions have died from a deadly virus. His mission: track down Patient Zero, the woman who had all three strains of DNA that produced the virus and assassinate her.

A couple and their friend join a mysterious religious sect in order to lead a more spiritual existence and find a new direction in life. They soon learn, however, that their new-found direction may take them further than they ever thought possible.

Young and artistic Claire Linkwood, who struggles financially to make ends meet, volunteers for a surrogate mother program. But after the embryo is successfully implanted at the clinic, she begins to have nightmares of a most "alien" nature.

The lone survivor (Jere Burns) of a space shuttle disaster discovers he's greatly transformed since surviving the crash. For one, his body seems to be indestructible, and he embraces a new-found humanity…courtesy of The Outer Limits.

Mona Lisa, an android who was created to spy and kill, is designed with superior intelligence. But it is that superior intellect which allows her to evolve, leading her to question the morality of her prime directive...and her own existence.

A biogeneticist clones successfully his wife, who is near death in a coma with no expectation of survival. But when his real wife suddenly awakens from her coma, he finds life with not one, but two wives may be quite complicated.

A man (Enrico Colantoni) has second thoughts about a process that transmits a copy of a person light years away but requires that the human "shell" left behind be destroyed in order to maintain a balance in the Universe.

When most people think of deserts, we think of punishing heat, camels and rattlesnakes. But dig a little deeper, and unbelievable stories emerge, like a bleeding tree, and a desert filled with salt.
We have always been fascinated by what lies beneath our feet. Some cultures have feared the underworlds, while others have believed that the earth houses our ancestors.
Many cultures believe that human life began in the forest, and for that reason, a deep connection to the plants and animals is always treasured by those who live amongst the trees.
The Latin phrase Terra firma means “solid earth”. From ancient history, man has utilized the Terra firma beneath his feet for many reasons but most strikingly to create homes out of the solid earth.
Mountains provide a splendid backdrop for communities but they’re also important ecological landscapes. Approximately one-tenth of the world’s population depends on mountains for their life-support.

Deserts. Forests. Caves. Mountains. How have human beings adapted to living in the world’s most extraordinary environments? The sheer magnificence of the natural world takes centre stage in this exploration of some of Earth’s most beautiful and most unforgiving environments and the people who have, against the odds, made these places their home.
